# Modern Home Blinds

> Custom blinds and window coverings manufactured locally in Oakville, Ontario and installed across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) — usually within one week. Family-run, with free in-home consultation and measurement.

Modern Home Blinds designs, manufactures, and installs made-to-measure window treatments for homes and condos throughout the GTA. Products are produced locally in Oakville (not imported), and every quote includes professional measurement and installation. All custom blinds and shades carry a 5-year warranty; motorized components carry a 3-year warranty.

Last updated: 2026-06-29

## Products (per-window pricing, installed)
- [Zebra Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/zebra-blinds.html): Alternating sheer and solid fabric bands for adjustable light control. $190–$290 per window.
- [Roller Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/roller-shades.html): Light-filtering, blackout, and solar-screen fabrics; clean, minimal look. $160–$260 per window.
- [Roman Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/roman-shades.html): Soft fabric folds that stack neatly when raised. $240–$420 per window.
- [Cellular (Honeycomb) Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/cellular-shades.html): Honeycomb cells for excellent insulation and energy efficiency. $200–$350 per window.
- [Skylight Cellular Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/skylight-cellular-blinds.html): Honeycomb shades engineered for overhead and angled skylight windows. $280–$480 per window.
- [Silhouette Shades](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/silhouette-shades.html): Fabric vanes floating between sheers for diffused light. $250–$450 per window.
- [Soft Vertical Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/soft-vertical-blinds.html): Soft fabric vanes for patio doors and large windows. $140–$240 per window.
- [Faux Wood Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/faux-wood-blinds.html): The look of real wood in moisture-resistant composite slats. $150–$250 per window.
- [California Shutters](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/california-shutters.html): Classic adjustable-louvre panels in PVC or wood for privacy and insulation. $300–$500 per window.
- [Wood California Shutters](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/wood-california-shutters.html): Real hardwood plantation shutters with adjustable louvres. $350–$550 per window.
- [Vinyl California Shutters](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/vinyl-california-shutters.html): Moisture-proof PVC plantation shutters for kitchens and baths. $300–$450 per window.
- [Custom Draperies & Sheers](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/draperies-sheers.html): Floor-to-ceiling, fully lined, sewn to exact dimensions. $350–$600 per window.
- [Outdoor Patio Awnings](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/outdoor-patio-awnings.html): Retractable awnings and exterior sun shades. Quoted per project.
- [Motorized & Smart Blinds](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/motorized-blinds.html): Quiet motors with remote and Google Home / Alexa / Apple HomeKit support. +$200 per window.
- [Smart Film](https://www.modernhomeblinds.ca/smart-film.html): Switchable privacy glass film for instant frosting. Quoted per project.

## Pricing notes
- Prices above are per window, installed (measurement + labour included).
- Condo / high-rise installations: +10%.
- Windows taller than 8 ft: +15%.
- Final pricing is confirmed after a free in-home measurement. HST not included.

## Key facts
- Manufactured locally in Oakville — not imported.
- Free in-home consultation and measurement, with no obligation.
- Typical turnaround: consultation to installation in under one week.
- 5-year warranty on blinds and shades; 3-year warranty on motors.
- Smart-home / motorization options available on most products.
- Canadian owned and operated; family-run.
